 ADVERTISEMENT   Filtered By: Topstories News PCSO Lotto Results: 3 bettors split P15-M Mega Lotto 6/45 jackpot on Oct. 23 
 By GMA News Published October 23, 2026 11:44pm 
 + Add GMA on Google Make this your preferred source to get more updates from this publisher on Google. Courtesy: Screenshot/PCSO Three bettors will split the P15-million Mega Lotto 6/45 jackpot in Friday's draw, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) said.
 The winning combination was 01-02-25-07-19-03.
 The tickets were purchased from outlets in Laguna, Valenzuela, and Nueva Ecija.
 Meanwhile, the P430,857,884.28 Ultra Lotto 6/58 jackpot remained unclaimed after no bettor matched the winning numbers 14-38-44-25-52-47. — VBL, GMA News
